create_mood_report_description: Please fill out the following questions to create your daily mood report. This will help you track your mental health and provide valuable insights for your well-being.
banner_warning: How are you doing? We have noticed some concerning trends in your logs. Please consider reaching out to a mental health professional for support if you or people around you find this trend concerning!

mood.description: Estimate your mood for the day. Remember that low mood can be depression, but also fatigue, feelings of hopelessness or ahedony. High mood can be happiness but also stress, anxiety or irritability.

sleep.description: Estimate your sleep for the day.

meds.description: Have you taken your medication today?

resources.description: Here are some resources that may be helpful for you:

resource1.title: Your Doctor or Therapist
resource1.description: If you have specific questions about your condition, consult your healthcare practicioner or therapist. They can provide personalized advice and support.

resource2.title: Emergency Services
resource2.description: If you are in crisis and need immediate support, always contact Emergency Services by calling you local SOS number.

resource3.title: International Bipolar Foundation (IBPF)
resource3.description: The IBPF provides resources, support, and education for individuals living with bipolar disorder and their families.
